Petersenhttps://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/hoth/dark/small/blizzardscout1.html My favorite Dark Card. Enough said. Well, that would not make much of a card extra, would it? What combat vehicle is a staple of nearly every dark deck: the "Chicken Walker"! Take a look at the finalists decks from the 1997 World Championships, the mighty [[Blizzard Scout 1]] makes an appearance in both decks. Let's dissect this beauty. The [[Blizzard Scout 1]] is the AT-ST which made an extremely brief sprint across the screen during the Empire Strikes Back. What they didn't tell you in the movie was that [[Darth Vader]] was being whisked to the Echo [[Cloud City: East Platform (Docking Bay){{!}}Docking Bay]], and, by the way, he trampled [[Major Bren Derlin]] on his way in to the hangar (Sorry Mr. Claven) [You see, [[Major Bren Derlin]] was talking to [[2-1B (Too-Onebee){{!}}2-1B]] about this snowman who was the spitting image of Richard Nixon.... TRAMPLE]. [[Blizzard Scout 1]] is the prototype of the Imperial's AT-ST cards which will come in Return of the Jedi expansions. This unique walker boasts everything you look for in a card. The Chicken Walker (named as such for its awkward look) is a natural in the mountains of [[Hoth (Dark){{!}}Hoth]] ([[Hoth: Mountains (6th Marker){{!}}Hoth: Mountains]], the [[Hoth: Mountains (6th Marker){{!}}6th Marker]]), where it deploys for 2 and has power 4, a great ratio. But wait, let's take a very typical game situation, [[Darth Vader]] is at the Defensive Perimeter waving his lightsaber at [[Commander Luke Skywalker]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi{{!}}Obi-Wan]] and Captain [[Han Solo{{!}}Han]]. Although they are out of sagacious gifts from the mentor or witty comments about not getting cocky (see the chicken theme), they decide to pick on our poor Dark Lord and initiate a battle. Well, Mr. [[Grand Moff Tarkin{{!}}Tarkin]] just hops aboard his [[Blizzard Scout 1]] and reacts all the way over to join his comrade in arms. This interlude brings up the real benefits of [[Blizzard Scout 1]]. First, it boasts a landspeed of 3, the ability to react, a permanent pilot and a slot to fill with a pilot -- a great package deal. Remember there are several 3 ability Dark Side Pilots out there. Second, just look at that destiny, a 4! Perfect to keep your average destiny up, and pulling one of these as destiny for [[Trample]] will squash all of those pesky Light Side spies. (OK OK, if Obi, [[Luke Skywalker{{!}}Luke]], [[Princess Leia]], [[BoShek]] or [[Yoda]] pull off [[Plastoid Armor]] and get [[Undercover (Dark){{!}}Undercover]] it will miss, but don't get technical with me!) Third, the walker is forfeit 5, a great way to soak up damage (just remember to lose the pilot first). Finally, there is also an S-comp link for good measure. Drawbacks. That is a tough one with the mighty Chicken Walker. But there are a couple. This walker does not have any immunity to attrition, despite its 4 armor rating. The other drawback is more of a reminder, [[Blizzard Scout 1]] does not count towards [[Walker Garrison]] as it is not an AT-AT. Forget that arrogant [[General Veers]] in his hulking [[Blizzard 1]], live life on the edge, blaze across the [[Hoth (Dark){{!}}Hoth]] tundra in search of rebels to trample under foot with the all-powerful Chicken Waaaaalker! CARD COMBOS: [[Blizzard Scout 1]] + [[Admiral Motti]] + Snowtroopers (at other locations) = Keep your leader on the move to respond to battles. [[Blizzard Scout 1]] + [[Trample]] = Rebel Spies in the Lost Pile. [[Blizzard Scout 1]] + [[Boba Fett]] + [[Trample]] vs. [[Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca]] = Blizzard Scout 1 + [[Boba Fett]] vs. [[Han Solo]] (could have saved the imperials a lot on bribing [[Lando Calrissian (Dark){{!}}Lando Calrissian]]). [[Blizzard Scout 1]] + [[Tatooine (Dark) (Premiere){{!}}Tatooine]] Sites = With the vast number of [[Tatooine (Dark) (Premiere){{!}}Tatooine]] Sites, [[Blizzard Scout 1]] is your all-purpose scout combat vehicle! |combos=* [[Blizzard Scout 1]] + [[Admiral Motti]] + Snowtroopers (at other locations).[https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Blizzard%20Scout%201 Scomp: Blizzard Scout 1]; card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json swccg-card-json Light.json] (commit d4e661ec). Petersen My favorite Dark Card. Enough said. Well, that would not make much of a card extra, would it? What combat vehicle is a staple of nearly every dark deck: the "Chicken Walker"! Take a look at the finalists decks from the 1997 World Championships, the mighty [[Blizzard Scout 1]] makes an appearance in both decks. Let's dissect this beauty. The [[Blizzard Scout 1]] is the AT-ST which made an extremely brief sprint across the screen during the Empire Strikes Back. What they didn't tell you in the movie was that [[Darth Vader]] was being whisked to the Echo [[Cloud City: East Platform (Docking Bay){{!}}Docking Bay]], and, by the way, he trampled [[Major Bren Derlin]] on his way in to the hangar (Sorry Mr. Claven) [You see, [[Major Bren Derlin]] was talking to [[2-1B (Too-Onebee){{!}}2-1B]] about this snowman who was the spitting image of Richard Nixon.... TRAMPLE]. [[Blizzard Scout 1]] is the prototype of the Imperial's AT-ST cards which will come in Return of the Jedi expansions. This unique walker boasts everything you look for in a card. The Chicken Walker (named as such for its awkward look) is a natural in the mountains of [[Hoth (Dark){{!}}Hoth]] ([[Hoth: Mountains (6th Marker){{!}}Hoth: Mountains]], the [[Hoth: Mountains (6th Marker){{!}}6th Marker]]), where it deploys for 2 and has power 4, a great ratio. But wait, let's take a very typical game situation, [[Darth Vader]] is at the Defensive Perimeter waving his lightsaber at [[Commander Luke Skywalker]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi{{!}}Obi-Wan]] and Captain [[Han Solo{{!}}Han]]. Although they are out of sagacious gifts from the mentor or witty comments about not getting cocky (see the chicken theme), they decide to pick on our poor Dark Lord and initiate a battle. Well, Mr. [[Grand Moff Tarkin{{!}}Tarkin]] just hops aboard his [[Blizzard Scout 1]] and reacts all the way over to join his comrade in arms. This interlude brings up the real benefits of [[Blizzard Scout 1]]. First, it boasts a landspeed of 3, the ability to react, a permanent pilot and a slot to fill with a pilot -- a great package deal. Remember there are several 3 ability Dark Side Pilots out there. Second, just look at that destiny, a 4! Perfect to keep your average destiny up, and pulling one of these as destiny for [[Trample]] will squash all of those pesky Light Side spies. (OK OK, if Obi, [[Luke Skywalker{{!}}Luke]], [[Princess Leia]], [[BoShek]] or [[Yoda]] pull off [[Plastoid Armor]] and get [[Undercover (Dark){{!}}Undercover]] it will miss, but don't get technical with me!) Third, the walker is forfeit 5, a great way to soak up damage (just remember to lose the pilot first). Finally, there is also an S-comp link for good measure. Drawbacks. That is a tough one with the mighty Chicken Walker. But there are a couple. This walker does not have any immunity to attrition, despite its 4 armor rating. The other drawback is more of a reminder, [[Blizzard Scout 1]] does not count towards [[Walker Garrison]] as it is not an AT-AT. Forget that arrogant [[General Veers]] in his hulking [[Blizzard 1]], live life on the edge, blaze across the [[Hoth (Dark){{!}}Hoth]] tundra in search of rebels to trample under foot with the all-powerful Chicken Waaaaalker! CARD COMBOS: [[Blizzard Scout 1]] + [[Admiral Motti]] + Snowtroopers (at other locations) = Keep your leader on the move to respond to battles. [[Blizzard Scout 1]] + [[Trample]] = Rebel Spies in the Lost Pile. [[Blizzard Scout 1]] + [[Boba Fett]] + [[Trample]] vs. [[Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca]] = Blizzard Scout 1 + [[Boba Fett]] vs. [[Han Solo]] (could have saved the imperials a lot on bribing [[Lando Calrissian (Dark){{!}}Lando Calrissian]]). [[Blizzard Scout 1]] + [[Tatooine (Dark) (Premiere){{!}}Tatooine]] Sites = With the vast number of [[Tatooine (Dark) (Premiere){{!}}Tatooine]] Sites, [[Blizzard Scout 1]] is your all-purpose scout combat vehicle! |combos=* [[Blizzard Scout 1]] + [[Admiral Motti]] + Snowtroopers (at other locations). * [[Blizzard Scout 1]] + [[Trample]] [[Trample]] opponent's undercover spies. * [[Battle Deployment]] * [[Veers (V)]] |also_known_as=* Chicken Walker }}

It is the same image saved as a GIF: same size, same transparent rounded corners, same words and layout; the GIF format's reduced colour palette only adds slight colour banding (clearest in the lightsaber icon at the lower left). It is 114 foil cards (57 per side): 87 very rare foils, 25 super rare foils, and 2 ultra rare foils ([[Darth Vader]] and [[Luke Skywalker]]). Displays shipped with oversized, non-playable objective box toppers. Packs are 18 cards, MSRP $4.95, 30 packs per box. Each pack has '''one foil''' from the list below plus random reprints from earlier expansions. Those reprints are not listed here. A foil of a title not on this list is not a Reflections pack foil.
